dimensions.name: day_type
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN is_weekend THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END

dimensions.name: age_band
dimensions.expr:
CASE WHEN age IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
     WHEN age < 18 THEN '0-17'
     WHEN age < 35 THEN '18-34'
     WHEN age < 50 THEN '35-49'
     WHEN age < 65 THEN '50-64'
     ELSE '65+' END

dimensions.name: insurance_status
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN insurance_provider_id IS NULL THEN 'No insurer on file' ELSE 'Insured' END

measures.name: uninsured_patients
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FILTER (WHERE insurance_provider_id IS NULL)
